title: Sonam Wangchuk moves HC against ‘house arrest’

ai.summary: Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk filed a petition challenging a 60-day house arrest imposed by Ladakh administration to prevent protests, amid demands for Ladakh statehood and postponement of December elections due to winter and student migration.

facts.claim: Ladakh administration imposed restrictions on Wangchuk’s movement for 60 days
facts.quote: Last week, the Ladakh administration had imposed restrictions on Wangchuk’s movement for 60 days, citing the need to prevent him from holding protests.

facts.claim: The order prohibits holding rallies, processions, or gatherings
facts.quote: The administration had directed the climate activist to refrain from holding rallies, processions, or gatherings.

facts.claim: The order cites Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
facts.quote: In terms of Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, restrictions were imposed on Sonam Wangchuk on his movement and direct him to refrain from engaging in any activity, organising or participating in any unauthorised rally, procession or public gathering, or any conduct likely to cause a breach of public peace, disturbance of public tranquillity or obstruction to the peaceful conduct of the ongoing electoral processes within the territorial jurisdiction of Leh district.

facts.claim: Wangchuk filed a petition in the Leh bench of the High Court of JK&L
facts.quote: Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk has filed a petition before the Leh bench of the High Court of Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, challenging his house arrest.

facts.claim: LAB and KDA seek deferment of December 4 elections
facts.quote: The move comes amid an appeal by the Leh Apex Body (LAB) and Kargil Democratic Alliance (KDA) on Wednesday to the President, Prime Minister, Union home minister, and Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha, Rahul Gandhi, seeking deferment of the December 4 elections to the Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Council (LAHDC).

facts.claim: Ladakh MP Haneefa Jan sought postponement of polls
facts.quote: Ladakh MP Haneefa Jan also wrote to Union home minister Amit Shah seeking postponement of the polls.

facts.claim: LAB and KDA demand statehood and constitutional safeguards for Ladakh
facts.quote: LAB and KDA are also spearheading an agitation for the statehood and constitutional safeguards for Ladakh under Article 371.

facts.claim: The violence on September 24, 2025 killed four people
facts.quote: They have been holding talks with the central government over these demands. The talks are taking place amid continuing discontent over the September 24, 2025, violence, when four people, including a retired soldier, were killed and more than 80 were injured.

ai.background_note: Ladakh's push for statehood under Article 371 has led to ongoing agitation, with demands for election postponement due to winter migration and student movements.
